chars.YASSINE: YASSINE: a Moroccan man in his thirties wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a young Moroccan woman wearing a tight emerald-green hijab, a long beige trench coat and gold hoop bracelets
chars.ILYAS: ILYAS: a Moroccan man wearing a red-and-black checked flannel shirt, black jeans and a grey beanie
chars.LOVER: LOVER: a tall man wearing a shiny black leather jacket, a thick gold chain and sunglasses pushed up on his head

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Cozy Moroccan-style living room with a salon sofa. SALMA stands pointing insistently at a house sale document on the coffee table, eyebrows raised demanding; YASSINE sits with arms crossed, frowning suspiciously at her. Open tension between them, comic mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SALMA sits at a laptop on a desk, typing with a sly sneaky smile; behind her in the doorway YASSINE watches her quietly with narrowed suspicious eyes.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan cafe terrace with mint tea glasses. YASSINE leans in whispering a secret plan to ILYAS, who raises one hand in surprise. Conspiratorial mood.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Apartment entrance. YASSINE stands at the open front door holding a rolling suitcase, waving goodbye; SALMA waves back with an exaggerated happy fake smile, eyes sliding sideways.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: ILYAS opens the door of his small apartment and welcomes YASSINE, who arrives secretly with his suitcase, both looking over their shoulders sneakily.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: YASSINE stands on a small stool hiding a tiny security camera on top of a bookshelf in a living room, finger on his lips, mischievous expression.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, dim living room lit by a lamp, seen from a high corner angle like a security camera view. SALMA tiptoes in through the front door pulling LOVER by the hand, both giggling secretly.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night. YASSINE and ILYAS sit side by side on a sofa staring at a glowing laptop screen (screen turned away from viewer), both with jaws dropped and eyes wide in total shock, ILYAS covering his mouth with his hands.
